comment: No family is given for the frequency input or for the eight outputs: in the LFO range they are slow control voltages and in the OSC range they are audio, and the switch on the panel decides which. The LFO frequency is ten to the power of the knob, over a knob range of -2 to 2, so 0.01Hz to 100Hz (oktagon.cpp:84, :58); the OSC frequency is C4 times two to the power of the knob plus the CV (oktagon.cpp:91). The maker's README describes this as two quadrature LFOs stacked, which is where the name comes from.
